name: Hotel Management
summary: The degree Breda is known for: four years of hotel and hospitality operations taught largely by doing, with placements in the industry and a second modern language alongside English. Admission turns on a motivation letter, an assignment and — for an applicant with a non-Dutch diploma — a personal video message, rather than on your grades.

notes: A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.
